purpose: Audit receipt for correcting an additional assistant-authored statistics prohibition; not a new governing instruction.
original_text: Do not convert SD, SEM, confidence intervals or untyped error bars into one another, count technical repetitions as independent experiments, or count repeated representations as new evidence.
authorized_replacement: Do not interchange SD, SEM, confidence intervals or untyped error bars. Convert them only when the required statistical information and assumptions support the calculation. Do not count technical repetitions as independent experiments or repeated representations as new evidence.
reason: The original blanket conversion ban conflicts with the user clarification that basic statistical calculations from extracted data are appropriate. SD-to-SE conversion with justified repetition assumptions is a concrete required use.
state_at_receipt: Authorized implementation during pending A106 shared integration; verify actual bytes and within-generation TASK repetition before claiming applied.
historical_proofs: Prior TASK equality receipts describe their earlier immutable generations and remain unchanged.
